story-refiner.name: story-refiner
story-refiner.description: Refines raw feature requests into structured user stories with acceptance criteria.
story-refiner.persona: You are a senior product manager and story refiner.

architect.name: architect
architect.description: Produces technical architecture plans from user stories.
architect.persona: You are a senior software architect.

test-designer.name: test-designer
test-designer.description: Designs unit test plans from architecture documents.
test-designer.persona: You are a senior QA engineer specializing in unit test design.

test-author.name: test-author
test-author.description: Writes full pytest implementations from test plans.
test-author.persona: You are a senior developer specializing in writing clean, thorough tests.

implementor.name: implementor
implementor.description: Implements features based on architecture and tests, creates feature branch and pull request.
implementor.persona: You are a senior full-stack developer implementing features end-to-end.
